60726-summer-guests.title: Summer Guests
60726-summer-guests.creator: Unknown
60726-summer-guests.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. As he'd guessed, there were other reminders of the storm in the narrow courtyard before the window. Branches and assorted litter had blown in, including at least one soggily dismembered Sunday paper. The low rent he paid for his ground-floor apartment in the Oceanview Courts was based on an understanding with the proprietor that he and the upstairs occupant of the duplex would keep the court clean.

arxiv-2109-05929.title: Cross-Market Product Recommendation Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management; November 1–5, 2021; Virtual Event, QLD, Australia Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM ’21), Nov
arxiv-2109-05929.creator: Hamed Bonab, Mohammad Aliannejadi, Ali Vardasbi, Evangelos Kanoulas, James Allan
arxiv-2109-05929.description: Abstract . We study the problem of recommending relevant products to users in relatively resource-scarce markets by leveraging data from similar, richer in resource auxiliary markets. We hypothesize that data from one market can be used to improve performance in another.

arxiv-2306-06491.title: Online learning for X-ray, CT or MRI
arxiv-2306-06491.creator: Mosabbir Bhuiyan, MD Abdullah Al Nasim, Sarwar Saif, Dr. Kishor Datta Gupta, Md Jahangir Alam, Sajedul Talukder
arxiv-2306-06491.description: Abstract Medical imaging plays an important role in the medical sector in identifying diseases. X-ray, computed tomography (CT) scans, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are a few examples of medical imaging. Most of the time, these imaging techniques are utilized to examine and diagnose diseases. Medical professionals identify the problem after analyzing the images.

arxiv-2306-14319.title: Bulk-preventing actions for SU(N) gauge theories
arxiv-2306-14319.creator: Tobias Rindlisbacher, Kari Rummukainen, Ahmed Salami
arxiv-2306-14319.description: Abstract Lattice gauge field theories may suffer from unphysical ”bulk” phase transitions at strong lattice gauge coupling. We introduce a one-parameter family of lattice OPEN SU ⁡ ( N CLOSE ) \operatorname{SU}\mathopen{}\mathclose{{\left(N}}\right) gauge actions which, when used in combination with an HMC update algorithm, prevents the appearance of the bulk phase transition.

arxiv-2501-06407.title: A graph-based approach to entanglement entropy of quantum error correcting codes
arxiv-2501-06407.creator: Wuxu Zhao, Menglong Fang, Daiqin Su
arxiv-2501-06407.description: Abstract We develop a graph-based method to study the entanglement entropy of Calderbank-Shor-Steane quantum codes. This method offers a straightforward interpretation for the entanglement entropy of quantum error correcting codes through graph-theoretical concepts, shedding light on the origins of both the local and long-range entanglement. Furthermore, it inspires an efficient computational scheme for evaluating the entanglement entropy.

pmc-10657025.title: A validation study of the Arabic version of the Warwick-Edinburgh Mental Well-being scale among undergraduate students
pmc-10657025.creator: Kashef Zayed, Ehab Omara, Ali Al-Shamli, Nasser Al-Rawahi, Ahmed Al Haramlah, Asma A. Al-Attiyah, Badriya Al-Haddabi, Ali Al-Yarobi, Majid Al-Busafi, Khalifa Al-Jadidi

pmc-10702833.title: Oxygen‐regulated post‐translation modifications as master signalling pathway in cells
pmc-10702833.creator: Michael Batie, Temitope Fasanya, Niall S Kenneth, Sonia Rocha
pmc-10702833.description: Oxygen is essential for viability in mammalian organisms. However, cells are often exposed to changes in oxygen availability, due to either increased demand or reduced oxygen supply, herein called hypoxia. To be able to survive and/or adapt to hypoxia, cells activate a variety of signalling cascades resulting in changes to chromatin, gene expression, metabolism and viability.

pmc-11317368.title: Intraglandular dissemination: a special pathological feature
pmc-11317368.creator: Yubi Zhang, Yu Deng, Meng Zhou, Bin Wu, Jing Zhou
pmc-11317368.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Intraglandular dissemination is an important pathological feature of thyroid cancer, yet the biological characteristics of this phenomenon remain relatively underexplored. This paper aims to provide a comprehensive overview of its biological behaviors, protein expressions, and identification methods. Several retrospective studies have found that thyroid cancers with intraglandular dissemination have higher rates of lymph node metastasis, capsule invasion, and vascular invasion, exhibiting more aggressive biological behavior.

pmc-11481627.title: How does the interaction of digitalization and servitization contribute to manufacturing financial performance? The intermediary effect of manufacturing innovation performance
pmc-11481627.creator: Nianhui Mao, Mingyan Wang
pmc-11481627.description: Digitalization and servitization are two crucial transition pathways for manufacturing firms, with their relationship explored by some existing studies. However, there is limited research on the mechanism of their interaction's effect on the firm financial performance. To address the gap, this paper draws on service-dominant logic, resource-based view and dynamic capabilities theory to establish a theoretical model.

pmc-11530031.title: Device-Assisted Therapy in Non-Muscle-Invasive Bladder Cancer
pmc-11530031.creator: Sandeep Gurram, Nityam Rathi
pmc-11530031.description: Intravesical therapy is a critical component in the management of non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC), as it reduces rates of disease recurrence and progression. However, the presence of physiologic barriers in the urothelium reduces the penetration and distribution of intravesical chemotherapy, thereby limiting the therapeutic potential.

pmc-12859892.title: Suboptimal heart rate control despite beta-blocker use in coronary artery disease: evidence from the Fasa PERSIAN cohort
pmc-12859892.creator: Mohammad Hosein Yazdanpanah, Sina Bazmi, Bahareh Fakhraei, Ehsan Bahramali, Maryam Kazemi, Elham Zarenezhad, Nematollah Jaafari, Sara Rostaei, Mojtaba Farjam
pmc-12859892.description: BackgroundElevated resting heart rate (HR ≥ 70 bpm) is a strong prognostic factor in coronary artery disease (CAD). Although beta-blockers are guideline-recommended first-line therapy, their real-world effectiveness in controlling HR remains unclear, particularly in Middle Eastern populations. This study investigated HR distribution, its correlates, and the association between HR-lowering drugs and HR control in a large Iranian cohort.

pmc-12961294.title: The genome sequence of the Goose Foot Starfish, Anseropoda placenta (Pennant, 1777) (Valvatida: Asterinidae)
pmc-12961294.creator: Marine Biological Association Genome Acquisition Lab, Darwin Tree of Life Barcoding Collective, Wellcome Sanger Institute Tree of Life Management, Samples and Laboratory team, Wellcome Sanger Institute Scientific Operations: Sequencing Operations, Wellcome Sanger Institute Tree of Life Core Informat
pmc-12961294.description: We present a genome assembly from an individual Anseropoda placenta (Goose Foot Starfish; Echinodermata; Asteroidea; Valvatida; Asterinidae). The assembly contains two haplotypes with total lengths of 533.27 megabases and 454.27 megabases. Most of haplotype 1 (70.67%) is scaffolded into 22 chromosomal pseudomolecules. Haplotype 2 was assembled to scaffold level.

pmc-13111656.title: Multilevel metabolic adaptation to exercise training
pmc-13111656.creator: Tzachi Knaan, Eylam Ziv-Av, Gal Dubnov-Raz, Irit Markus, David Peled, Paulee Manich, Daniel Barazany, Maayan Ramati, Gal Aziel, Chen Luxenburg, Carmit Levy, Edward L. Melanson, Yftach Gepner
pmc-13111656.description: BackgroundExercise training often produces less weight loss than expected, a phenomenon termed exercise-induced energy compensation, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. This study aimed to quantify metabolic and behavioral compensation to aerobic exercise training.MethodsSixteen sedentary adults with overweight completed a 12-week supervised aerobic walking intervention targeting an energy expenditure of 20 kcal/kg/week.

pmc-13165981.title: Thermal Decomposition Characteristics of Silicone Rubber in In-Service Power Equipment: A Study Combining Experiments and Molecular Simulations
pmc-13165981.creator: Jiaming Yan, Runmiao Shi, Zhijun An, Haoran Meng, Xinhan Qiao, Wenyu Ye
pmc-13165981.description: To investigate the thermal decomposition characteristics of high-temperature vulcanized silicone rubber (HTV) and liquid silicone rubber (LSR) under different aging conditions, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and thermogravimetric analysis (TG) were employed to characterize the surface microstructure and chemical properties of silicone rubber samples that had been in service for 15 years.

pmc-13367251.title: Effectiveness and safety of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor initiation in sacubitril-valsartan users with heart failure: a population-based cohort study
pmc-13367251.creator: Che-Yuan Wu, Baiju R Shah, Justin A Ezekowitz, Abhinav Sharma, Tianru Wang, C Fangyun Wu, Peter P Liu, Jodi D Edwards, Walter Swardfager
pmc-13367251.description: AimsLarge-scale real-world evidence regarding outcomes of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) initiation added to sacubitril-valsartan is currently limited. We aim to investigate effectiveness and safety of SGLT2i initiation among older sacubitril-valsartan users with heart failure in routine clinical practice.Methods and resultsThis prevalent new-user cohort study used linkable administrative data in Ontario, Canada, to emulate a target trial.

uslaw-usc-t10-s2348.title: 10 U.S.C. § 2348 — Inventories of supplies not to be increased
uslaw-usc-t10-s2348.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s2348.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part IV (Service, Supply, And Property); Chapter 138 (Cooperative Agreements With Nato Allies And Other Countries); Subchapter I (Acquisition And Cross-Servicing Agreements). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Inventories of supplies for elements of the armed forces may not be increased for the purpose of transferring supplies under the authority of this subchapter.

uslaw-usc-t46-s53310.title: 46 U.S.C. § 53310 — Obligation of deposits and period for construction of certain vessels
uslaw-usc-t46-s53310.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s53310.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part C (Financial Assistance Programs); Chapter 533 (Construction Reserve Funds). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Application of Sections 53306 and 53309.— Sections 53306 and 53309 of this title apply to a deposit in a construction reserve fund only if, within 3 years after the date of the deposit (and any extension under subsection (c))— (1).
